part.title: OSI layers 5‑7 and service view
part.script: The top three OSI layers provide services to applications, handling sessions, data representation and user interfaces. Each of these layers has a distinct role: sessions manage dialogs, presentation formats and secures data, and application offers network‑aware services to users.

scenes.narration: The top three OSI layers provide services to applications, handling sessions, data representation and user interfaces.
Each of these layers has a distinct role: sessions manage dialogs, presentation formats and secures data, and application offers network‑aware services to users.

quick_check.question: Which OSI layer is responsible for data representation tasks such as encryption and compression?
quick_check.explanation: The Presentation layer handles syntax, encryption, compression, and other data representation functions.
